name: The Plaza of the Palm Beaches
aka: Trump Plaza of the Palm Beaches
address: 525 & 529 S Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: The Plaza of the Palm Beaches is a pair of 32-story condominium towers on South Flagler Drive with views of the Intracoastal Waterway. The towers opened in October 1985 and carried the Trump Plaza name from 1986 until 2021, when owners voted to change it.

name: Esplanade Grande
address: 201 S Narcissus Ave, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: Esplanade Grande is a 15-story boutique condominium on the west side of Flagler Drive, built above the downtown waterfront amphitheater near Clematis Street. It has about four residences per floor, each opening from a private elevator foyer.

name: 101 Lofts
address: 101 N Clematis St, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: 101 Lofts is a five-story loft-style condominium at the east end of Clematis Street. It overlooks the Clematis Street fountains, the Waterfront Green and the Intracoastal Waterway.

name: The Strand
address: 255 Evernia St, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: The Strand is a 15-story tower with 275 units and ground-floor retail, on the downtown block between Evernia and Datura streets. It opened as a rental building in 2002 and was converted to condominiums after it was sold in 2005.

name: 610 Clematis
address: 610 Clematis St, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: 610 Clematis is an eight-story condominium on Clematis Street, built around a central courtyard. The courtyard holds a pool, a sundeck and a zen garden.

name: City Palms
address: 480 Hibiscus St, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: City Palms is a ten-story condominium on Hibiscus Street in the Rosemary Square area, between One City Plaza and Two City Plaza. Its pool deck is on the sixth floor, and Clematis Street is a few blocks' walk away.

name: The Prado
address: 600 S Dixie Hwy, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: The Prado is an eight-story condominium on South Dixie Highway, within walking distance of Rosemary Square, the Kravis Center and Clematis Street. Its 304 units range from about 752 to 1,513 square feet, with a pool deck on the fifth floor.

name: The Metropolitan
address: 403 S Sapodilla Ave, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: The Metropolitan is an eight-story courtyard condominium on South Sapodilla Avenue, about a block from Rosemary Square, with a Venetian-style lobby and a rooftop pool deck.

name: Two City Plaza
address: 701 S Olive Ave, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: Two City Plaza is a 21-story condominium tower built by Kolter Homes in 2008, connected to the Rosemary Square district about two blocks from the Intracoastal. It is the sister tower to One City Plaza.

name: One City Plaza
address: 801 S Olive Ave, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: One City Plaza is a 16-story courtyard-style condominium built by Kolter Homes on South Olive Avenue near Okeechobee Boulevard. It has both traditional condominium units and loft units.

name: CityPlace South Tower
address: 550 Okeechobee Blvd, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: CityPlace South Tower is a 420-unit condominium tower on Okeechobee Boulevard, a couple of blocks from Rosemary Square. The Related Group developed it, and it opened in summer 2008.

name: The Tower Condominium at CityPlace
address: 651 Okeechobee Blvd, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: The Tower Condominium at CityPlace is a 12-story condominium on Okeechobee Boulevard in the Rosemary Square area. It is a separate building from CityPlace South Tower at 550 Okeechobee Boulevard.

name: Courtyards in CityPlace
address: 630, 720 & 780 S Sapodilla Ave, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: Courtyards in CityPlace is a mid-rise condominium community of buildings on South Sapodilla Avenue in the Rosemary Square area, with one-, two- and three-bedroom units.

name: Mr. C Residences West Palm Beach
aka: Mr. C Hotel & Residences West Palm Beach
address: 320 Lakeview Ave, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
amenities: fitness center with yoga and Pilates rooms
summary: Mr. C Residences West Palm Beach is a 27-story tower under construction at Lakeview Avenue and South Dixie Highway, combining 146 branded condominium residences with 110 hotel suites. Interiors are by Meyer Davis.

name: Banyan Tree Residences West Palm Beach
address: 400 Hibiscus St, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
developer: Mast Capital and Curated JCZM Development, with Banyan Group
summary: Banyan Tree Residences West Palm Beach is a planned 88-residence condominium tower at Hibiscus Street and South Dixie Highway, one block east of Rosemary Square, approved by the Downtown Action Committee in August 2026. Interiors are by Yabu Pushelberg.

name: The Residences at 464 Fern Street
address: 464 Fern St, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: The Residences at 464 Fern Street is a proposed 25-story residential tower on a full block bounded by South Dixie Highway, South Quadrille Boulevard, Fern Street and Gardenia Street. Plans filed in June 2026 are in municipal review.

name: Waterview Towers
address: 400 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: Waterview Towers is a 27-story, 132-unit condominium completed in 1981 that sits between Flagler Drive and the Intracoastal Waterway near Clematis Street. Units commonly look out on the Palm Harbor Marina, the Intracoastal and the island of Palm Beach.

name: The Slade
address: 1551 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
amenities: two heated pools (sunrise and sunset decks)
summary: The Slade is a 200-unit condominium completed in 2005 on the west side of North Flagler Drive, about 1.2 miles north of Clematis Street, with views across the Intracoastal. The building is credited to the architecture firm Arquitectonica.

name: Flagler Pointe
address: 1801 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
summary: Flagler Pointe is a roughly 400-unit condominium complex on North Flagler Drive, made up of a nine-story U-shaped main building and two three-story courtyard buildings. It offers one- to three-bedroom floor plans.

name: Portofino
address: 2600 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
summary: Portofino is a 10-story, 126-unit condominium tower from 1969 in the Northwood area. It stands on the east side of Flagler Drive, directly on the Intracoastal Waterway.

name: Flagler Landing
address: 3940 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
summary: Flagler Landing is a four-story condominium completed in 2007 directly on North Flagler Drive in the Northwood Shores area. Its amenities include boat docks and gated security.

name: Placido Mar
address: 5200 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
summary: Placido Mar is a 26-story, 145-unit condominium from 1974 in Northwood Harbor, on the Intracoastal side of North Flagler Drive. Listings describe Intracoastal frontage with a boat dock and pier.

name: The Palm Beach House
address: 5600 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
summary: The Palm Beach House is a 1978 high-rise condominium on the east side of North Flagler Drive, directly on the Intracoastal Waterway in Northwood Harbor. Listings mention a private sand beach and a waterfront pier.

name: Alba Palm Beach
address: 4714 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
developer: BGI Companies with Blue Road Group
amenities: private dock with day boat slips
summary: Alba Palm Beach is a 22-story, 55-residence condominium on the Intracoastal in Northwood. It also has two- and three-story townhomes with private plunge pools, and a private dock with direct Intracoastal boat access.

name: Alba Reserve
address: 4720 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
developer: BGI Companies with Blue Road Group
architect: Carlos Ott with Spina O'Rourke + Partners
amenities: eighth-floor amenity deck with two pools
summary: Alba Reserve is a proposed 31-story, 87-residence sister tower to Alba Palm Beach on a 2.72-acre site on North Flagler Drive. Plans include townhomes and penthouses.

name: Apogee
address: 4906 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
summary: Apogee is a proposed Related Group condominium on a 1.45-acre waterfront site in the Northwood Harbor area, reduced from earlier plans for 25 stories and 46 units.

name: The Residences at Mandarin Oriental, West Palm Beach
aka: Mandarin Oriental Residences, West Palm Beach
address: 5400 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
architect: Safdie Architects with Spina O'Rourke + Partners
summary: The Residences at Mandarin Oriental is a planned 31-story, 87-residence branded condominium on a three-acre Intracoastal site on North Flagler Drive. Interiors are by Studio Munge.

name: The Ritz-Carlton Residences, West Palm Beach
address: 1717 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
summary: The Ritz-Carlton Residences, West Palm Beach is a 27-story, 138-residence branded condominium on North Flagler Drive by the water. Interiors are by Rockwell Group.

name: Olara
address: 1919 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
summary: Olara is a two-tower waterfront development on North Flagler Drive: a 26-story tower with 275 condominiums alongside a separate rental tower. Interiors and amenity spaces are by Gabellini Sheppard Associates.

name: Shorecrest
address: 1865 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
amenities: rooftop pool deck with 75-foot lap pool
summary: Shorecrest is a 28-story, 98-residence condominium on North Flagler Drive with four residences per floor. Interiors are by Rottet Studio.

name: Rosewood Residences West Palm Beach
address: 2001 N Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
summary: Rosewood Residences is a planned 27-story, 90-residence condominium on a waterfront site on North Flagler Drive, approved by the City of West Palm Beach in June 2026.

name: Washington Tower
address: 2000 Presidential Way, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: Washington Tower is a 20-story, 114-unit condominium from 1972 in the gated Lands of the President community on Presidential Way, in the north end of West Palm Beach.

name: Envoy Tower
address: 2480 Presidential Way, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: Envoy Tower is a 20-story, 148-unit condominium completed in 1984, part of the gated Lands of the President complex on Presidential Way.

name: The Bristol
address: 1100 S Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
architect: Solomon Cordwell Buenz with Revuelta Architecture International
summary: The Bristol is a 25-story condominium tower on the Intracoastal Waterway on South Flagler Drive, completed in 2019. Its residences of about 3,700 to 9,000 square feet have three to five bedrooms.

name: Edgeworth
address: 1155 S Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: Edgeworth is a planned pair of curved 28-story condominium towers on South Flagler Drive, with interiors by MAWD (March and White Design). Construction is expected to start in 2027.

name: Trianon
address: 1200 S Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: Trianon is a high-rise condominium completed in 1972 on the Intracoastal side of South Flagler Drive, with two-bedroom, two-bath floor plans.

name: Forté on Flagler
address: 1309 S Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
developer: Two Roads Development and Alpha Blue Ventures
summary: Forté on Flagler is a 25-story condominium on the Intracoastal Waterway with interiors by Jean-Louis Deniot. It topped off in April 2024, and closings began in July 2025.

name: South Flagler House
address: 1355 S Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: South Flagler House is a pair of identical 28-story condominium towers on the Intracoastal Waterway, with interiors by Pembrooke & Ives. The project topped out in November 2025, and residents are expected in 2027.

name: La Clara
address: 1515 S Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: La Clara is a 25-story condominium on the Intracoastal Waterway with one- to three-bedroom residences of about 1,500 to 3,000 square feet. Its facade combines stucco, Roman travertine, coral stone and granite.

name: Viking Arms
address: 1527 S Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: Viking Arms is a three-story condominium on South Flagler Drive near the Norton Museum of Art, built in 1980.

name: Rapallo North
address: 1701 S Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: Rapallo North is the northern of the two Rapallo condominium towers on the Intracoastal side of South Flagler Drive, built in 1973.

name: Rapallo South
address: 1801 S Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
summary: Rapallo South is the southern of the two Rapallo condominium towers on South Flagler Drive, built in 1973, just north of the El Cid neighborhood.

name: Flagler Yacht Club
address: 3701 S Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33405
summary: Flagler Yacht Club is a small boutique condominium on the Intracoastal Waterway on South Flagler Drive, built in 1981, with a marina for residents.

name: Maison d'Or
address: 3705 S Flagler Dr, West Palm Beach, FL 33405
developer: Kolter Urban and Perko Development Partners
amenities: elevated pool deck with spa and cabanas
summary: Maison d'Or is a planned 19-story, 39-residence boutique condominium on the Intracoastal Waterway, with interiors by Hirsch Bedner Associates. It replaces the former Flagler House condominium, and sales launched in January 2026.
